svg.title: Set up Windows Dynamic Lock: Automatically lock your PC when you leave with your phone
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
Set up Windows Dynamic Lock: Automatically lock your PC
when you leave with your phone
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-11-08
First connect your phone to your PC
via Bluetooth
Dynamic Lock operates based on the Bluetooth
signal from a phone paired with the PC.
Turn on Dynamic Lock in Sign-in
options
In Settings, go to Accounts > Sign-in options,
then find Dynamic Lock under Additional settings
below.
Understand the conditions that trigger
locking
Microsoft Learn explains that Dynamic Lock locks
the PC only when the Bluetooth signal drops and
the system is idle.
Steps to check after setup
1) Take your phone and walk a few steps away
from the PC. 2) Wait about 1 minute and see
whether the PC screen locks. 3) Return to your…
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
